exposure: in vitro fertilisation and embryo transfer (IVF-ET)
cohort: 1677 women with singleton pregnancies who gave birth consecutively between 20 and 37 weeks of gestation at Seoul National University Bundang Hospital between April 2013 and October 2018 and underwent placental pathologic evaluation.
finding: IVF-ET was independently associated with an increased risk of placental infarction in women with preterm births.
